title: Final Probability Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct final expression for the probability of finding the system in an excited state.

title: Wavefunction Expansion
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly expand the wavefunction in terms of energy eigenstates.

title: Perturbation Application
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly apply the perturbation theory to derive the coefficients.

title: Correct Initial Conditions
description: Important Criteria: The student should state the correct initial conditions for the coefficients.

title: Integration Result
description: Optional Criteria: The student may provide the correct result of the integral involved in the calculation.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common errors such as sign mistakes in the coefficients or integration.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student may check for consistency in units throughout the derivation.
